verdict.rationale: v0's own Projects docs list domains among the things a Project shares alongside deployment and hosting, and v0 deploys to Vercel infrastructure. That suggests domain handling for published apps, but nothing documents actually connecting a custom domain. missing for 10: documented custom-domain connection workflow, DNS/verification steps, plan availability for custom domains, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: One Project shares deployment, hosting, domains, and environment variables for the chats connected to it.
Deploy with one click to secure, scalable infrastructure powered by Vercel.
When multiple chats share a Project, deploying from any of them updates the same production URL.
